candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get diarrhoea for 3 days. E dey drink poorly. Eye dey sunk. Skin pinch normal. E no dey restless or irritable. No blood for stool. Di pikin no dey cough or get difficult to breathe. E no get fever. Dem no see ear problem. E never get convulsion before and e no dey convulse now. E no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything.

fact_evidence.evidence_text: E no dey restless or irritable.
Di pikin no dey cough or get difficult to breathe.
E no dey lethargic and e dey conscious.
